name: Beijing Capital Eco-Environment Protection Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Capital Eco-Environment Protection Group Co., Ltd. engages in the environmental protection business in China and internationally. The company provides urban and rural water supply, sewage treatment and reclaimed water, integrated water supply and drainage, pipeline operation and maintenance, and sludge treatment and disposal, and build a comprehensive protection system for water resources, water security, and water environment; sanitation, solid waste treatment and disposal, and environmental restoration services; and atmospheric environment services.
